captions: Graduation Festival
Each printed matter of the “Graduation Festival 2014” is based on a Wordpress blog.
Starting from the website of this project, posters, banners, flyers and an approx.
200-page exhibition catalogue were generated, which was printed on demand on
site. Students were able to update images of their final project during the “Graduation
Festival” and visitors were thus able to take away an up-to-date printed version of the
catalogue as a unique copy each day. Later program items, such as award winners or
impressions of the festival, could also be included in the catalogue thanks to the on
demand concept.
